basic_details.job_title: IIM Udaipur Chief Operating Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre, a Technology Business Incubator of the Indian Institute of Management Udaipur, is inviting applications for one contractual post of Chief Operating Officer- Impact Programs. The consolidated remuneration is 14-20 Lakhs (Gross, Annual), commensurate with experience, and the post needs 10–15 years of executive or leadership experience. Apply online through the JOBS tab of www.iimu.ac.in; the last date to receive applications is 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre
content_sections.text: The IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre is a Technology Business Incubator that fosters innovation and entrepreneurship. It is supported by IIM Udaipur and the National Science and Technology Entrepreneurship Development Board (NSTEDB) under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. The centre is starting projects to improve the livelihood of rural and tribal communities in Rajasthan and to scale micro-enterprises, and the Chief Operating Officer will lead and monitor these projects so that deliverables and milestones are met on time.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's degree in Management (MBA/PGDM), Social Work (MSW), Development Studies, Rural Management, Public Policy, or any related discipline. A Bachelor's degree with substantial relevant experience may also be considered. 10–15 years of executive/leadership experience, preferably in the social sector, rural development, livelihood or development programs. Experienced in strategic planning, project execution and risk mitigation. Strong professional network with foundations, not-for-profit organisations, CSR institutions and social-sector enterprises. Innovative and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities, market linkages and revenue streams for micro-enterprises. The age limit printed in the notice is "Preferably above 30 years". The notice prints no age relaxation and no cut-off date for counting age.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is 14-20 Lakhs (Gross, Annual), commensurate with experience. The nature of the post is contractual. The Chief Operating Officer reports to the Chief Executive Officer. The notice does not state the length of the contract or any allowances.

content_sections.heading: IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre Chief Operating Officer- Impact Programs Job Description
content_sections.text: Lead the overall planning, execution and monitoring of Impact Programs. Develop strategic plans, operational frameworks, timelines and performance targets. Oversee end-to-end implementation of rural development, tribal entrepreneurship and livelihood initiatives. Lead, manage and mentor project managers, field teams and implementation partners. Build and maintain relationships with government departments, funding agencies, NGOs and other key stakeholders. Monitor project budgets, resource allocation, expenditure and compliance with funding guidelines. Establish monitoring and evaluation systems to track program progress, outcomes and impact. Ensure timely preparation of high-quality project reports, MIS and donor/government reports. Conduct regular field visits to review implementation and resolve operational challenges. Identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies and ensure timely achievement of program deliverables. Strengthen operational processes, SOPs and systems for effective program delivery.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Udaipur Incubation Centre Chief Operating Officer- Impact Programs
content_sections.text: Applicants are requested to apply online through the link provided at the institute's website, www.iimu.ac.in , under the JOBS tab. The last date to receive applications is 10 November 2026; the notice prints no time. The notice names no documents and no application fee. For queries, the institute's page lists the phone number +91 294 2477100.
